entries.content: MP3/OGG Vorbis decoder fully implemented. Added minimp3.h and stb_vorbis.c to third_party/. decodeMp3() uses minimp3 for frame-by-frame decoding, decodeOgg() uses stb_vorbis. All audio formats (WAV/MP3/OGG) now fully decodable. Phase 49 complete.

Phase 64 debug tools implementation complete. 19 debug files created (Picker, AIView, AnimScrub, etc.). DebugMenu.cpp integrated 18 new tabs. STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION duplicate resolved. FPS limiter added to game_loop_coordinator.

Third-party libraries location: app/src/main/cpp/third_party/. minimp3/ (MP3 decoder), stb/ (OGG Vorbis decoder), JoltPhysics/ (physics engine). minimp3.h and stb_vorbis.c are header-only with IMPLEMENTATION macros.

Audio system status: WAV/MP3/OGG decoding complete. AudioManager uses OpenSL ES for playback. Audio data stored as 16-bit PCM. Files located in app/src/main/cpp/audio/. audio_decoder.h/.cpp, audio_manager.h/.cpp, audio_stream.h/.cpp.
Build successful as of 2026-09-18. 4 architectures (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, x86_64). Latest commit: 52128399 on master. Working tree clean.
